parent_objective: audit group metric result before objective-update design
blocked_by: M1342 confirms group-level conflict but route to update design versus projection repair has not been chosen
supersedes: direct pair-group actor update without group metric audit

public_gates: M1343 must not update actor weights
M1343 must not use private holdout
M1343 must preserve actor input contract
M1343 must audit group metrics and select a route

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M1342 group metrics and chooses objective-update design versus projection repair or synthesis
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, actor-update, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if audit routes directly to actor update without design
stop if private holdout is used
fallback_plan: if group metrics are accepted, route to bounded pair-group objective-update design
if projection artifact dominates, route to source-current projection repair
if branch has enough evidence for cadence synthesis, route to branch synthesis
if metrics disagree with M1340, audit discrepancy
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1342 confirms exact group-level conflict metrics

training_stage.stage_objective: materialized source-history pair-group metric result audit
admission_evidence: PPO and actor update remain blocked
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: route is selected before objective update

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1343 audits zero-context source-current group metrics and cannot claim closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit grouped correct-history versus wrong-history residuals from M1342
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Group conflict must remain explicit before update design.
allowed_claims: materialized source-history pair-group metric result audit
no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: The M1342 group metrics can be audited into a safe next route before any pair-group objective update.
success_criteria: audit cites M1342 group counts and conflict fractions
audit cites family and fold group summaries
audit chooses bounded objective-update design, projection repair, or branch synthesis
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, actor update, checkpoint load, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: audit routes directly to PPO or actor update
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1343 passes as a process audit if it summarizes M1342 group evidence and selects one safe next route before any objective update, PPO, private holdout, promotion, or actor-input expansion.
